format.description: ida, dif, ips, ips32 or json.

relocationEdits.description: Relocation-table entry rewrites exported (2-byte edits in .reloc).

changedBytes.description: File bytes that differ from the original (patches, relocation edits and the PE checksum).

records.description: Entries in the script (ida), changed-byte lines (dif), records (ips) or patches (json).

checksumUpdated.description: The recomputed PE checksum is part of the export (the original had a non-zero checksum).

originalSha256.description: SHA-256 of the original file the patches apply to.
